t: To buy oneself | WordReference Forums
s: April 3, 2007 - My grammar book tells me: I bought myself a watch. -> "Buy" is not a reflexive verb because it can be used without the reflexive pronoun: I bought a watch. Compare: I hurt myself. -> "Hurt" (as a transitive verb) needs an object or reflexive pronoun. So, "buy" can be used with a reflexive pronoun, but it's not necessary.
